title: The Incidence of Congenital Undescended Testis Among Dutch Infants
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the incidence of congenital undescended testis of mature boys, at one year of age, born in the Medical Centre Alkmaar (MCA).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* mature newborns (\>/= 37 weeks)
* born in the Medical Centre Alkmaar

Exclusion Criteria:

* premature newborns (\< 37 weeks)
